name: thermal-p1
title: Thermal Master P1
description:
Stream the Thermal Master P1 (InfiRay-OEM) USB thermal camera on the Snapmaker U1. The P1 is not a UVC/V4L2 camera, so the hardware-accelerated camera plugin cannot see it; this plugin drives it directly over libusb, colormaps the 16-bit thermal frame, and serves it as MJPEG at /thermal. No UVC, no firmware flashing, no Rockchip MPP dependency.

To register it as a camera in Fluidd and Mainsail, add the /thermal endpoint by hand under Settings → Cameras (MJPEG stream).
tagline: libusb-driven MJPEG streaming for the Thermal Master P1 thermal camera.
